extracted.name: Hearty Chili con Carne
extracted.description: Spicy chili con carne with ground beef, kidney beans, tomatoes, onions and garlic. Delicious served over rice.
ingredient_lines: 3 (14.5 ounce) cans whole peeled tomatoes with liquid, chopped
2 (15.25 ounce) cans red kidney beans, rinsed and drained
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a medium stockpot over medium heat. Cook and stir onion, chile pepper, and garlic until softened, about 5 minutes. Add ground beef; cook and stir until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Drain excess grease if needed.
Pour in tomatoes with liquid, salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder, paprika, oregano, cinnamon sticks, and cloves. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
Stir in kidney beans, and cook another 15 minutes. Remove cinnamon sticks before serving.
